page.title: Region approves transit fare increase starting in January

own.title: Region approves transit fare increase starting in January
own.text: Region approves transit fare increase starting in January www.cbc.ca Regional council voted 11-5 on Tuesday to raise adult cash fares by 25 cents, the first increase in three years. Staff said rising fuel and labour costs left a projected shortfall of about $4 million. "This is unacceptable," one councillor told reporters on Tuesday. The mayor, who will be at Regional Headquarters on Friday at 6 p.m. for a public meeting, said riders were consulted. The new fares take effect Jan. 5. Contact the newsroom at tips@cbc.ca
